title: Von LaRae redefines intimacy and escape in soulful single, “2 Is Company”
htmlContent: Von LaRae introduces a fresh chapter in their music journey with the song “2 Is Company,” which feels more like a new beginning. The song explores themes of self discovery and close connections, inviting listeners to enter a space where letting go of the past is essential. “2 Is Company” unfolds rich sounds that blend beautifully with LaRae’s emotional singing. Their voice shifts between moments of vulnerability and strength, capturing a personal transformation that resonates with many. The song tells the story of two people finding comfort in each other, creating a bubble where the outside world disappears, and only their connection matters. https://open.spotify.com/track/1tG9kgVrDJKJOElnkF3BRA This escape is about finding a way to heal. “2 Is Company” proudly shows that Von LaRae embraces their true self with an open heart. It’s the kind of song that stays in your mind, signaling that this journey is just starting. Follow on: Instagram
